title: Hon'ble Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment to chair the 5th Meeting of the National Council for Senior Citizens (NCSrC)
subtitle: Ministry To Launch e-Book titled "SNEHA - Stories of Nurturing, Engagement, Happiness & Active Ageing"
body_text:
The Hon'ble Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment, Dr. Virendra Kumar will chair the 5th Meeting of the National Council for Senior Citizens (NCSrC) tomorrow at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre (DAIC), New Delhi.
The meeting will be attended by the representatives of Central Ministries, Departments, State Governments and Union Territories, Oldest Members of Parliament, National Commissions, experts in the field of ageing, representatives of Senior Citizens' Associations, Pensioners' Associations and Non-Governmental Organisations working for the welfare of senior citizens.
The Council will deliberate upon key issues concerning the welfare of the Senior citizens. The deliberations are expected to further strengthen inter-ministerial convergence and reinforce the Government's commitment towards ensuring a life of dignity, security, participation and well-being for senior citizens, in line with the vision of Viksit Bharat @2047.
On this occasion, the Ministry will also launch "SNEHA - Stories of Nurturing, Engagement, Happiness & Active Ageing", an e-book showcasing major events initiatives and achievements of the Senior Citizen Division from October 2024 to June 2026.
Pertinently, the National Council for Senior Citizens (NCSrC) reconstituted vide Gazette Notification dated 17th February, 2012, is the apex advisory body of the Government of India on issues relating to the welfare, protection and empowerment of senior citizens.

enrichment.summary: Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment Dr. Virendra Kumar will chair the 5th meeting of the National Council for Senior Citizens (NCSrC) at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi, bringing together central and state representatives, MPs, national commissions, experts, and NGOs working on elderly welfare. The Council will discuss key issues concerning senior citizens' welfare to strengthen inter-ministerial convergence in line with the Viksit Bharat @2047 vision. The Ministry will also launch an e-book titled 'SNEHA - Stories of Nurturing, Engagement, Happiness & Active Ageing', documenting achievements of the Senior Citizen Division from October 2024 to June 2026.
enrichment.context:
The National Council for Senior Citizens (NCSrC) was reconstituted via a Gazette Notification dated 17th February 2012 and serves as the apex advisory body of the Government of India on matters relating to the welfare, protection, and empowerment of senior citizens. It plays a role akin to other advisory councils in facilitating inter-ministerial and Centre-State coordination on ageing-related policy, given that elderly welfare spans multiple domains—health, pensions, social security, and legal protection (e.g., the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007). With India's population ageing rapidly, senior citizen welfare has become a priority area under schemes like the Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY), National Action Plan for Senior Citizens (NAPSrC), and Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana, which focus on healthcare, social security, and quality of life for the elderly.

This meeting reflects the government's continued institutional engagement with ageing issues within the broader Viksit Bharat @2047 vision, which emphasizes inclusive development for all demographic groups. The launch of the SNEHA e-book also signals an effort to consolidate and publicize achievements of the Senior Citizen Division, potentially serving as a reference for policymakers and researchers tracking the evolution of India's elderly welfare ecosystem.
